## Description

Optimizes institutional order liquidation trajectories by minimizing worst-case expected execution cost over a Wasserstein ambiguity set of temporary and permanent market impact parameters.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, illiquid asset liquidation under uncertain market impact models.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles, historical volume participation curves, impact coefficient ranges.

## Caveats

Robust minimax optimization reformulations lead to semi-definite programming (SDP) problems.
